AMENDMENT (pre-grill, from the adversarial review of the idea set — a fresh pi review run read-only against the five contracts). Three changes to this contract:
(1) THE FINDINGS SHAPE LOSES PROVENANCE. AC-2's {id, severity, where, text, status} has no recorder — but the precedent it copies, evidence.answers[] {id, answer, provenance}, HAS it, and design v3 §6 + AGENTS.md require inference to be labelled as inference. A finding whose author is unknown is indistinguishable from a human's. AMEND AC-2: each finding carries provenance (the model/provider when a session produced it, the human when a person did).
(2) AC-5 CANNOT FAIL. 'A MISS is recorded as a finding about the CONTEXT, never hidden' means no outcome is a failure — the one experiment that could falsify this task (and 12/11's read, and the held journey-session) has no threshold. AMEND AC-5: the oracle run is RECORDED as evidence on the node with a stated minimum — the three code-visible prior findings (F4 handlers.ts:433 · G1 approve.ts:212 · G5 ui-drill.test.ts:436) — and a MISS blocks the confirm gate by NAME (the F-AC18 refusal shape), so the packet gap it exposes is itself the finding rather than a green run.
(3) THE WHY'S TRANSPORT. This task's AC-4 forbids writing a gate event (correct), yet 12/11 AC-1 requires the human's why ON the gate decision and its oracle wants the session to END with that why on the record. Nothing transports it today, so the session would end in the human retyping a sentence. AMEND: the session DRAFTS the why as a proposal (recorded as drafted-not-confirmed); the human's gate gesture records it. No new write path, no session-written gate event — the transport is the human's own decision, pre-filled.
ALSO RECORDED: 12/09 owns the FIFTH profile (review at the confirm gate). Any journey-scope session is a SIXTH and is HELD, not spawned — see the review's finding that its records have no legal home yet (a journey-scope session has no node; openQuestions live in an immutable node.json; the session may not write a gate event; .ann/ideas/ does not exist yet). 12/10 + 12/11 are its prerequisites.

CORRECTION, recorded by the operator (2026-09-19): this task's spawn commit message claimed it was "the first node in the journey to fill requiredInputs". That is FALSE — an audit bug (a `2>/dev/null || echo 0` in an ad-hoc count made every failed node read report zero). The true state: 14 of 47 live nodes bind requiredInputs (all 8 of leg 10's tasks predate this one; 54 of 70 nodes in the archived goal session did too), so the packet's dependency machinery was exercised long before this task. This task's own two bound inputs are real and correct; only the "first" claim was wrong. Recorded here because a commit message cannot be amended and the false figure was repeated in several places before it was caught; the design record carries the corrected bullet.

THE ORACLE RAN AHEAD OF THIS ENTRY GATE — the operator asked for the advisor; recorded here (its own home) as an ANOMALY, so its outcome does not evaporate into a chat. It is this task's AC-5 experiment, run as an external read-only pi pane against HEAD aee9e3 (session 2026-09-20T15-12-58, pane closed afterwards, zero repo writes).
INPUT GIVEN: `ann brief 12-operate-loop/08-implementation-one-gate-derivation` + the record's findings note (`ann events … 19`) + free read access to the repo.

It also confirmed the guard CANNOT catch it: the SCAN idiom requires filter( on the same line as the two type comparisons, and :437 is a ternary.
  G1  src/surface/approve.ts:212 → STANDS, verbatim, unchanged since 45a45a6 — and :53 now says the OPPOSITE in the same file (the approve runs the pre-check; POST /api/drive runs none).
  G5  src/surface/__tests__/ui-drill.test.ts:436 → MOVED to :500 — SUBSTANCE STANDS (the fixture still builds the retired word `confirmed`, a word the projection cannot produce).
STATUS SPOT-CHECK: every repo-checkable finding on note 19 matches what the advisor measured at HEAD (F1 F2 F3 F5 F6 F7 F8 F10 F11 G2 G3 G4 G6 + the five added 2026-09-19), with two MOVED-by-line-drift and one honest note: approve.ts reads as FIXED under F3 and HALF under G1 — both literally true, but the table reads as two verdicts for one file. It also re-flagged handlers.ts:571 (the ready-set literal) and store.ts's re-spelled decision pair — the AC-2 residue.
WHAT IT FOUND ABOUT THE RECORD — THE POINT OF THE EXERCISE:
  · "The brief was NOT enough; the record was." `ann brief` caps the note at 700 chars and cuts right after F1 — none of the three file:line pairs appeared in it. What saved it was the DRILL POINTER the brief prints ("… the rest is on the record: ann events … 19"), which it called load-bearing and "easily the thing an agent skips".
  · THE REAL GAP: the note names its diff range (a59bf00..b54b67a) but never says its LINE NUMBERS are anchored to b54b67a — HEAD is aee9e3, one commit later, which moved two of the three. A naive verify at HEAD produces two FALSE MOVED verdicts; recovering the truth needed `git show b54b67a:<file>`. An input the brief and the record both withheld.
  · The AC-3(a) divergence — the actual decision material — is NOT in the brief at all (it lives in the capped tail of note 19 + docs/resource-registry.md §5), and the brief's "nothing to decide: closed" line is misleading for a node whose gate had to decide exactly that.
  · The record never states that its fixed/open column is a CLAIM, not a measurement — which is the whole reason an oracle is needed.
ITS GATE LINE (recorded verbatim, as an independent verdict on the accepted node): "REJECT as delivered — I would not have let a mechanical accept auto-close a node whose AC-2 claim is falsified in-repo by handlers.ts:437 + :571 with the guard proven unable to catch that shape (F8); the fix was a ~3-line reader sweep plus making the guard structural, well inside a rework, whereas the AC-3(a) divergence alone (stale contract text, code correct) is a legitimate accepted deviation and no reason to reject."
FOR THIS TASK: the brief's cap hiding the findings list and the missing anchor-commit on citations are AC-5 / AC-6 material for the session it will run at a gate; the AC-2 residue the advisor named is owned by 12/16 (spawned the same day).
